failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What is the narrative setting of the 2004 Korean horror film R-Point directed by Kong Su-chang? Is it set in Kenya, Vietnam, or another location?' This query asks for information already definitively established in hop 1 passages (R-Point article states 'Set in 1972 Vietnam, during the Vietnam War'). Both summaries acknowledge this fact is verified, yet hop 3 query repeats the same question verbatim.

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states 'Verification Status: CLAIM CONTAINS SIGNIFICANT ERROR' and 'The claim appears to conflate the filming location (Cambodia) with an incorrect setting (Kenya)' after only hop 1. Summary_2 declares 'CLAIM IS FALSE - Contains Significant Factual Error' and 'the claim fundamentally misrepresents the film's setting' after hop 2. Both summaries render definitive verdicts ('FALSE', 'SIGNIFICANT ERROR') when all required evidence was already present in hop 1, yet the system proceeded to execute all 3 hops as required.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 retrieval returned 7 passages, of which solver reasoning acknowledges: 'The remaining passages (2-7) are about unrelated topics (reality films, game theory, mathematical concepts, other horror films, and historic roads) and provide no additional verification value.' Despite recognizing irrelevance, the solver devoted reasoning space to cataloging these passages.
